start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:start-from-the-persons-own-work." Plan something for a person (their week, a training season, a launch, a trip), design something for them (a screen, a programme, a logo) or advise them on a choice (keep or sell, which offer, what to do next), starting from their own work: find what their own body of work already says on the topic (their own frameworks, philosophy, notes, recordings, past AI conversations, files and pursuits), apply each of their frameworks and principles to the request, and give the result citing their own words with where each is kept, so the person never has to point an AI to their own material.
